nodes.name: Magnetic-field-assisted chemical deposition
nodes.procedure: Chemical deposition with the assistance of a magnetic field was applied to fabricate a NiFe alloy, then a thin NiFe oxyhydroxide layer was formed in situ on the surface of the NiFe alloy because of the nanoscale confinement effect and finally, a hierarchical Ni–Fe oxyhydroxide@NiFe alloy nanowire array was synthesized.
nodes.source_text: For nanowire array electrocatalysts with large current density, the chemical deposition with the assistance of a magnetic field was applied to fabricate a NiFe alloy... hierarchical Ni–Fe oxyhydroxide@NiFe alloy nanowire array was synthesized

nodes.name: Hydrothermal route assisted with calcination
nodes.procedure: Ni/MoO2@CN/NF nanoneedles with a three-phase heterojunction were fabricated through a hydrothermal route assisted with calcination.
nodes.source_text: Ni/MoO2@CN/NF nanoneedles with a three-phase heterojunction were fabricated through a hydrothermal route assisted with calcination (Fig. 6e)... it only needed 1.86 V to drive 1000 mA cm⁻² in 6 M KOH solution at 60 °C

nodes.name: Water bath reaction-assisted ammonia annealing
nodes.procedure: A Ni-MoN nanorod array catalyst was synthesized on Cu foam via a water bath reaction-assisted ammonia annealing reduction method, resulting in forming a unique nanorod-nanoparticle structure.
nodes.source_text: A Ni-MoN nanorod array catalyst was synthesized on Cu foam via a water bath reaction-assisted ammonia annealing reduction method

nodes.name: Two-step hydrothermal with phosphorization
nodes.procedure: Ternary Ni₂(₁₋ₓ)Mo₂ₓP nanowire arrays were prepared through a two-step method.
nodes.source_text: Ternary Ni₂(₁₋ₓ)Mo₂ₓP nanowire arrays were prepared through a two-step method

nodes.name: One-step solution method
nodes.procedure: Ni₃S₂-embedded NiFe LDHs with rich porous nanosheets were synthesized through a facile and fast one-step solution method at room temperature.
nodes.source_text: Ni₃S₂-embedded NiFe LDHs with rich porous nanosheets were synthesized through a facile and fast one-step solution method at room temperature

nodes.name: Sulfur-modified corrosion with electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Ultrathin NiS nanosheets were grown on a Ni foam for 3 h at 50 °C through a sulfur-modified corrosion method, and NiFe LDH particles were electrodeposited on NiS nanosheets for 300 s.
nodes.source_text: Ultrathin NiS nanosheets were grown on a Ni foam for 3 h at 50 °C through a sulfur-modified corrosion method, and NiFe LDH particles were electrodeposited on NiS nanosheets for 300 s

nodes.name: Two-step hydrothermal with electrochemical activation
nodes.procedure: Electrochemical activation of Ni₃S₂/NF (prepared by a two-step hydrothermal method) resulted in a Ni(OH)x/Ni₃S₂/NF nanosheet array with abundant micropores.
nodes.source_text: Electrochemical activation of Ni₃S₂/NF (prepared by a two-step hydrothermal method) resulted in a Ni(OH)x/Ni₃S₂/NF nanosheet array

nodes.name: Electrodeposition with high-temperature nitridation
nodes.procedure: A Co₄N–CeO₂/GP nanosheet array was synthesized through electrodeposition and high-temperature nitridation, which is a selective reaction process.
